items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'You ever hear Boyd Rayburn play...' and the interviewee responds 'Yeah.'

ctx.x: Piccolos? What's the clarinet doing there?" I said, "What clarinet, man? Say, "Can't you hear the clarinet players?" I said, "Yeah, I hear them. Play it again, you know?" He said, "Well, what do you think they're doing?" So I'd fool around and try to do it on the piano. And he said, "You're going to be a good arranger someday." "That's what you gotta do; you gotta see what you've been (inaudible) see these guys are doing. They'll be out here a long time with all the credits." He says, "We do those things like…
You ever hear Boyd Rayburn play "Boyd Meets Stravinsky?"
